waypoints.name: Esmeralda Trailhead (#1394)
waypoints.directions: From I-90 Exit 85 east of Cle Elum, take SR-970 to Teanaway Road and follow the North Fork Teanaway Road. Where the pavement ends at 29 Pines Campground, take the right fork, FR 9737, about 10 miles to its end at the Esmeralda Basin Trailhead (about 4,270 ft). A Northwest Forest Pass is required.

waypoints.name: Fortune Peak Summit
waypoints.directions: Follow the Esmeralda Basin Trail a short way and turn right onto Ingalls Way #1390, climbing to Ingalls Pass (about 6,500 ft). Take the upper of the two trails above Headlight Basin toward Lake Ingalls for about half a mile, then leave it and go cross-country up the east slopes (firm snow early season, loose talus after melt-out) to the ESE ridge at about 7,050 ft. A good boot path follows the ridge to the summit.
